name: innovation-platform
description: Build and ship apps on your organization's Innovation Platform: create an app via the inno-platform MCP server as a container (any stack, the default type), a function (its own Cloudflare Worker), or an MCP server for AI assistants (mcp-function / mcp-container) behind the platform's own front door, write it against the platform's application + app-security contracts, run the security gates before shipping through CI/CD, and manage access to a live app.

platform_url.title: Platform MCP address
platform_url.description: Your platform's MCP address, ending in /mcp. Your platform's panel shows it on its Connect Claude Code card.
